source_citation: Barneby taxonomic monograph via New York Botanical Garden

morphology_source_reported.habit: Diffuse prostrate tufted perennial from yellow root
morphology_source_reported.stems: Usually 3–35 cm, silky hairs spreading or retrorse
morphology_source_reported.leaves: Usually 4–7 pairs of leaflets, 2.5–8 mm long, lower surfaces with rows of glands
morphology_source_reported.inflorescence: Ovoid to oblong raceme, hairy axis 1–6 cm
morphology_source_reported.flowers: Calyx 4.7–8(–8.8) mm, hairs conspicuous; banner whitish or yellowish with changing reddish eye and darker keel
morphology_source_reported.fruit: Pod 2.3–3 mm, lustrous brown seeds 1.7–2.4 mm

cautions: Monograph's infraspecific variability not fully reviewed; detailed species characters source-transcribed, not verified
